spell.aurorion_magia.dolor_cruciatus.gui: Channel raw pain into a target in sight. While it lasts they bleed fast, the agony stops them walking and jumping, and no spell or item answers the hand of someone being tortured.
spell.aurorion_magia.imperium_mentis.gui: Impose your will on a mind. Creatures fight for you; people lose their bearings and cannot cast or use what they hold.
spell.aurorion_magia.vinculum_carnificis: The spot where the target was struck becomes the anchor of an invisible chain, and it has no time limit. They walk, fight and cast freely inside the radius — but crossing the line drags them back and makes them bleed, harder every time. Pearls, teleports, milk and totems do not save them. Cast again on them to open the chain.
spell.aurorion_magia.transpositio.guide: You and the target swap places in an instant — and swap speed and fall as well. Save an ally, trap an enemy or escape a siege.
spell.aurorion_magia.manus_carnificis: Manus Carnificis — Hand of the Tormentor
spell.aurorion_magia.manus_carnificis.gu: Hold a creature in the air and steer it with your gaze. Release to hurl it — hitting a wall hurts.
spell.aurorion_magia.manus_vacua.guide: Rip the item from the target's hand and throw it to the ground. While sneaking, takes the off-hand instead: shield, totem, focus.
spell.aurorion_magia.genua_flecte.guide: "Bend the knee." The target drops to their knees before you: barely able to move, no jumping, no sprinting, nothing in their hands works and no spell comes out — but they can still speak. Cast again on them to let them rise.
spell.aurorion_magia.vox_interdicta.guid: Take someone's voice. Nothing they say is heard, in chat or out loud, and no spell leaves their mouth. Cast again on the same target to give the voice back. Crouch to silence everyone around you, except your allies.
spell.aurorion_magia.sigillum_clausum.gu: Seal a door, trapdoor, gate, chest, barrel, a backpack on the ground, or anything with an inventory — including other mods'. Nobody opens, breaks or carries it away except you and, with more mastery, your team. A seal of equal or higher level breaks yours.
spell.aurorion_magia.deiectio_corporis.g: A brutal force nails the target to the ground: no wings, no flight, no levitation. Sneaking, the wave opens around you and drops everything airborne within the radius. Anyone already grounded takes the impact and cannot jump for a moment.
spell.aurorion_magia.lux_vorata.guide: The light around you is devoured: candles, campfires, lamps and fire go out, and everyone inside the radius is left in Darkness — except you and your team.
spell.aurorion_magia.ferrum_ligatum.guid: The target's armor and off-hand item are bound to their body: they won't come off, swap or drop.

%1$s succumbed to the pain inflicted by %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.aurorion_magia.deiectio_cor: %1$s was driven into the ground by %2$s
%1$s was driven into the ground by %2$s using %3$s
ui.aurorion_magia.lacre_time: You and your team can open
aurorion_magia.inscricao_negada: You cannot inscribe %s: this spell was not taught to you.
aurorion_magia.mente_turva: Your mind is not your own. No spell answers.
aurorion_magia.corrente: The chain won't let you go.
aurorion_magia.nada_a_roubar: There is no motion to steal.
aurorion_magia.desarmado: Something tore away what you were holding.
aurorion_magia.ferro_vinculado: The iron closes over your body.
aurorion_magia.nada_a_lacrar: There is nothing here that can be sealed.
aurorion_magia.lacre.resisted: The seal holds: a stronger hand made it.
aurorion_magia.lacre.full: There are too many seals in this world.
spell.aurorion_magia.tempus_sistere.guid: Forbidden spell. A shadow the size of a great hall opens on the ground and time stops inside it: people, creatures, arrows in flight — except you. No one moves, strikes or uses anything; they can only look. It stays that way until you cast again.
spell.aurorion_magia.mortem_dico.guide: Forbidden spell. "I declare death." The target dies at once: no armour, enchantment, shield or totem saves them. From the second level on, cast while sneaking, a pentagram opens on the ground and kills everything inside it — allies included.
spell.aurorion_magia.dolor_universus.gui: Forbidden spell. Everyone around you is lifted off the ground and held there, paralysed with pain, bleeding for as long as you hold the spell, with lightning falling around the seal. Radius, height and pain grow with mastery.
death.attack.aurorion_magia.mortem_dico: %1$s had death declared upon them by %2$s
%1$s had death declared upon them by %2$s using %3$s
%1$s had death declared upon them by %2$s
death.attack.aurorion_magia.dolor_univer: %1$s succumbed to the torment of %2$s using %3$s
spell.aurorion_magia.aspectus_captus.gui: "Look at me when I am talking to you." The target's gaze is locked on you: they walk slowly and speak, but cannot turn away. Sneaking, a huge eye opens above you and the whole square is forced to stare.
spell.aurorion_magia.mundus_vacuus.guide: Take the world away from someone. The target stops seeing every person and creature around — they are all still there, talking and striking, but to them the place is deserted. Cast again on the same target to give the world back.
ui.aurorion_magia.alternar: Cast again on the same target to undo
aurorion_magia.dor_demais: The pain lets no word out.
aurorion_magia.de_joelhos: On your knees, your hands do not obey.
death.attack.aurorion_magia.vinculum_car: %1$s was torn apart by the chain of %2$s
%1$s was torn apart by the chain of %2$s using %3$s
spell.aurorion_magia.submersio.guide: Fill someone's lungs with water on dry land. Their air runs out, the body grows heavy and the drowning begins - and everything that saves you from a dive saves you here: Respiration, a potion, milk. Cast it again on the same target to give the air back.
spell.aurorion_magia.unda_magna.guide: A wall of water bursts out of you and throws everything away, dousing anyone on fire and sweeping even arrows out of the air. Standing, it opens in the arc ahead of you; sneaking, in every direction at once.
spell.aurorion_magia.carcer_aquae.guide: A sphere of water closes around the target and holds them in place: they cannot walk, flee or be carried away - but they still breathe, see and hear. Any blow from outside bursts the bubble and frees them.
spell.aurorion_magia.ventus_custos.guide: Everyone around you is hurled out of the circle, and a wall of wind stays where you stood: anyone trying to enter is pushed back, harder every time. It does not heal and does not stop damage - what it buys is distance.
spell.aurorion_magia.columna_venti.guide: An updraft rises from the ground wherever you look. Whoever steps into it is lifted and comes down light. It harms no one and picks no side: your enemy rises just as easily as you do.
spell.aurorion_magia.turbo_ventorum.guid: A funnel of wind forms ahead of you and travels in a straight line, dragging everything in its path toward its axis and hurting whoever cannot get out. It breaks apart the moment it meets a wall.
ui.aurorion_magia.carcer_resgate: Any blow from outside breaks the bubble
ui.aurorion_magia.barreira_empurra: Pushes back anyone trying to enter
ui.aurorion_magia.queda_lenta: Slow falling on the way up
ui.aurorion_magia.puxa_e_fere: Pulls to the centre and wounds

passive.aurorion_magia.manus_medica.guid: Each melee hit restores half a heart and slowly heals the worst injury without taking health. The target feels the impact and recoils; several hits are needed for a full recovery.
passive.aurorion_magia.presenca_terrivel: Anyone nearby feels fear: the world goes dark, the screen closes in black and the heart races. A shadow spreads at your feet with a black magic circle, dark smoke rises from your body, shapes crawl out of the ground and voices whisper all around. Everyone nearby drops to the ground, and creatures flee. Switch it on and off with /aurorion passivas.
aurorion_magia.passiva_como_ligar: Switch it on and off with %s
item.aurorion_magia.pergaminho_passiva.a: Reading consumes the scroll. The mark stays with the character.
commands.aurorion_magia.passiva_sem_inte: %s has no switch: it is always on.
aurorion_magia.subtitle.dread.heartbeat: A heart beats far too hard
ui.aurorion_magia.sem_prazo: No time limit: lasts until released
ui.aurorion_magia.alternar_zona: Cast again to let time flow
spell.aurorion_magia.impetus_venti.guide: You burst forward riding the wind, and nothing can knock you aside. On arrival the ground cracks and everyone within 5 blocks is hurled into the air for about 1.5 s, unable to cast. At level 1 the impact only lifts; from level 2 on it also deals damage.
